name: Hong "Diana" Zhao
office: City of Walnut, Member of the City Council

items.text: Hong "Diana" Zhao is a licensed clinical social worker and former supervisor at the Los Angeles County Department of Children and Family Services. She retired in 2023 after 16 years with the agency. Zhao is now director of the Win Win Relationship Learning Center. She has served as a city commissioner and community volunteer.

sentences.text: Hong "Diana" Zhao is a licensed clinical social worker and former supervisor at the Los Angeles County Department of Children and Family Services.
She retired in 2023 after 16 years with the agency.
Zhao is now director of the Win Win Relationship Learning Center.
She has served as a city commissioner and community volunteer.

items.text: Her platform includes reducing traffic congestion, improving road safety near schools, and expanding sidewalks and bike lanes. She proposes stronger collaboration with the sheriff's department, a city app for public safety alerts, and better emergency preparedness. Zhao supports helping small businesses, attracting restaurants, promoting mental health awareness, expanding senior wellness programs, supporting affordable senior housing, holding regular town halls, and creating a resident feedback system.
